close_reason: Obsolete after the integrated producer-owned callable construction model (8cb9b7a90, folded in a20f29ab3). Production now builds an empty FnId closure-target registry and lowers every CallClosure/TailCallClosure with direct_target=None; public closures are already keyed and entered by NativeCallableBoundaryId. Replacing the empty registry with boundary-keyed entries would recreate the alternate model that fz-k22.23 removed. Verified at 939fdacdf: the exact two-distinct-Enum.map repro returns [2,4,6,8] then [100,200,300,400] on interp and run; closure_typed_captures, curried_add, and multi_caller_spec_divergent each pass run/interp/build. Remaining work is deletion under fz-9i4.4.4.
description: Cleanup of legacy callable reconstruction is blocked by a model assumption: NativeCodegenSurface currently treats closure target surfaces as unique by target FnId, but shared Enum.find/find_value-style helpers can have multiple callable-boundary surfaces for the same target FnId. Acceptance: native codegen carries boundary-keyed/direct-surface-keyed closure target surfaces; direct closure-call resolution selects the callable-boundary surface when the closure var has a boundary id; no-boundary singleton direct calls still use a direct-only fallback; then build_codegen_closure_targets and its stale expected-failure regression can be deleted in fz-9i4.4.4.
title: Native closure target surfaces are keyed by callable boundary identity, not only target FnId
